_source_note: Affiliation type, methods, availability status and contact visibility are copied word for word from Table S1 (Appendix A of the build brief). Career stage was revised by JO on 2026-09 (dropped "mid-career researcher or professional", added "practitioner or professional (non-academic)", and "other" became "other (please specify)" with a free-text career_stage_other field) -- it no longer matches Table S1 word for word, deliberately. Ecosystem / realm focus was replaced by JO on 2026-09 with a 16-value biome list (see check_vocab.py ECOSYSTEM_FOCUS_CANONICAL) -- it also no longer matches Table S1, deliberately; this is the single source for that list, used identically by the Create-a-profile field, the Search filter and the Map study-area ecosystem-type filter. The existing dev-seed placeholder profiles still use the old 10-value list and will no longer match this vocabulary until replaced with real profiles. Countries are ISO 3166-1 official short names (via the pycountry package). Languages are ISO 639-1 names (the two-letter subset of ISO 639, chosen as the practical list for a working-languages field; pycountry's full ISO 639 table also carries ISO 639-2/3/5 codes for thousands of historical and minority languages not useful in a dropdown). ES topics were revised by JO on 2026-09 from the 40 CICES v5.1 Group-level names to a curated 63-class subset (Class level, one level below Group), still extracted from the official spreadsheet at cices.eu (Finalised-V5.1_18032018.xlsx), never typed from memory or invented (see check_vocab.py ES_TOPICS_CANONICAL). It keeps every Provisioning and Regulation & Maintenance and Cultural class from the Biotic half, plus only the four water-supply classes from the Abiotic Provisioning half (drinking and non-drinking surface/ground water); it drops all abiotic energy, mineral and 'Other non-aqueous' classes and all Regulation & Maintenance (Abiotic) and Cultural (Abiotic) classes. Each entry keeps its official CICES `code` and `class` name (the stored, exported value is `"<code> <class>"`, unique even for the three same-named "Other" catch-all classes) plus a JO-authorised `label` -- a short plain-language phrase for display only, never stored in place of the official name. `section` groups entries into the three top-level CICES sections (Provisioning / Regulation and maintenance / Cultural) for the Create-a-profile field's and the Search filter's searchable, expandable-by-section UI (src/components/EsTopicsField.jsx). The existing dev-seed placeholder profiles still use the old 40 Group-level names and will no longer match this vocabulary until replaced with real profiles. work_scale was added by JO on 2026-09 as a new optional Expertise field, not present in Table S1 -- the spatial scale a member works at -- checked as its own canonical list in check_vocab.py, same as career_stage, ecosystem_focus and es_topics. A thematic_focus field (cross-cutting research themes) was added alongside it and then, also on 2026-09, merged into sectors rather than kept separate: sectors is now a 14-value combined list (the original seven Table S1 sectors plus thematic_focus's ten themes, with overlaps such as "climate adaptation"/"climate change adaptation" and "disaster risk"/"disaster risk reduction" collapsed to one wording each) -- it is no longer Table S1 verbatim, deliberately, and is checked against its own canonical list like the other revised fields. thematic_focus itself no longer exists as a field. project_stage was added by JO on 2026-09 as a new optional single-select Work field, not present in Table S1 -- the stage of a member's current work (idea/early planning, ongoing, seeking collaborators, or completed), so others know if a project is open to join -- checked as its own canonical list in check_vocab.py. open_to was revised by JO on 2026-09: "hosting visits / secondments" became "hosting visits" (the word "secondments" dropped, nothing else in the list changed) -- it no longer matches Table S1 word for word, deliberately, and is checked against its own canonical list like the other revised fields.
